def make_dict_of_responses(get):
        '''Make dictionary of student responses (aka "answers")
        get is POST dictionary.
        '''
        answers = dict()
        for key in get:
            # e.g. input_resistor_1 ==> resistor_1
            _, _, name = key.partition('_')
            answers[name] = get[key]

        return answers
